text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Guhh... Defeated yet again... A losing 
streak, it is...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I have no excuse to offer... neither to my 
fans, nor to you...
choice_data_list:
We still have a chance to win! Keep your 
chin up!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as expected of you. Even if I 
turn my back, you still serve as my 
guiding light."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time to get fired up again! If we 
don't look ahead, victory will slip right 
through our fingers!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"I'll reflect on what went wrong and put 
the lessons to good use! Next battle, 
victory will surely be ours!"
choice_data_list:
With this kind of positive attitude, there 
won't be any problem!

Let's make sure to keep putting in the 
effort!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Aye, 'tis thanks to thee. And to thee, 
next time I shall surely deliver victory.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Let us steadily build up our 
efforts.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
You cannot turn back the clock. If so, 
then let us at least live without regrets!
